newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Sept PPI up 1.4 pct m/m, 20.4 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Sept PPI up 1.4 pct m/m, 20.4 pct y/y.

text.p: BUDAPEST, Nov 7, Reuter - Hungary's producer price index rose 1.4 percent month on month in September and 20.4 percent year on year, the Central Statistical Office said on Thursday.
In August the monthly rise was 1.7 percent and year on year was 20.9 percent.
Domestic sales prices month on month were up 1.2 percent in September and 21.6 percent year on year. Export prices rose 1.9 percent month on month and 17.2 percent year on year.
